versions.content: Dcm behavior on sub-function stopSending with further pa- rameters On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with transmissionMode = stopSending and at least one periodicDataIdentifier is in the re- quest, the Dcm shall stop the scheduled periodic data transmissions for all requested and in the current session supported periodicDataIdentifiers.
